rules: freestyle, alternating, >=5 wins, no passes/captures/forbidden moves
assistance: Same state, instructions and criteria construction; code filters immediate wins then blocks, otherwise all legal moves with contiguous run/open end features
stopping: Stop on win, full board or first error; no automatic retries; no parameter tuning between games
limitations: Repeated empty-board games only; errors are not losses; no equal compute budget; LLM model ID may be a provider alias
